hypothesis_title: STR_1631_CROSS_FAMILY_3WAY — Heterogeneous Family Blender (Consensus × MLRA × Defense)
hypothesis_description:
Mega Sprint 5-Phase + Ensemble 종결 후 Judge L-225/248/249 권고 next_direction = heterogeneous_family_blender_sprint. 동일 family hyperparameter blend (TDC 0.834 same-family Kill) 한계 극복 위해 3개 이종 family alpha source를 cross-blend.

Slot A (Core 50%): STR_1631_SYN_05_2002 (4F Consensus core_alpha — Value/Quality/Momentum/Quality_Profitability)
Slot B (Diversifier 30%): STR_1656_MLRA (ML Risk-Adjusted family — XGBoost residual + adaptive)
Slot C (Defense 20%): H_1682 family Defense candidate (cross-family Q25+R16 또는 STR_1689_quality_aggregate / STR_1683_distress_calmar)

가설: 3 alpha source pairwise TDC ≤ 0.40 (true ensemble 자격) → tail dependence 차단 → SR 2.0+ + Harvey FF5 Pre-LB t_NW ≥ 2.95 + crisis_alpha ≥ 4.0 동시 달성. Lockbox artifact 회피 (Pre-LB와 Lockbox SR 비율 ≤ 1.30 enforce).

Success Hard Gates:
- Harvey Pre-LB t_NW ≥ 2.95 (full sample 3.0 X, Pre-LB가 진실)
- TDC pairwise ≤ 0.40 (3 pairs 모두)
- Crisis_alpha ≥ 4.0 (CRISIS regime SR)
- MDD ≤ -30%
- Pre-LB SR ≥ 1.50

Kill Triggers:
- Pre-LB Harvey t_NW < 2.50 → 즉시 Kill (Mega Sprint 회귀)
- Any TDC pair > 0.50 → same-family contamination
- Lockbox SR ratio > 1.50 → overfitting
- 20종 hard 위반

방법론: Optimizer Agent 자율 선택 (sleeve-based 또는 score-merged ERC). Family saturation 회피 강제 (각 slot 다른 economic family 검증 필수). LOO 검증 mandatory (각 slot out 시 영향).
